Assemble a lazy dataset from existing rasters.

as_dataset.Rd

Each entry of bands is either a single LazyRaster (one time slice, or an already-reduced composite) or a list of per-slice LazyRasters. Rasters on different graphs are imported into one shared graph.

Usage

as_dataset(bands, mask_asset = NULL)

Arguments

bands

A named list of LazyRasters or lists of LazyRasters.

mask_asset

Optional name of the QA/mask band within bands.

Value

A LazyDataset.

See also

lazy_dataset()
